import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
import torch
from torchvision import transforms, models
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import log_loss
import warnings

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")

INPUT_DIR = "./input"
SUBMISSION_DIR = "./submission"
os.makedirs(SUBMISSION_DIR, exist_ok=True)

breeds = []
sub_sample = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "sample_submission.csv"))
breeds = sub_sample.columns.tolist()[1:]

df_train_labels = pd.read_csv(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "labels.csv"))
id_to_breed = dict(zip(df_train_labels["id"], df_train_labels["breed"]))

# Helper to load images
train_images = []
test_images = []

for fname in os.listdir(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train")):
    if fname.endswith((".jpg", ".png")):
        tid = fname.split(".")[0]
        if tid in id_to_breed:
            train_images.append(
                {"id": tid, "path": os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "train", fname)}
            )

for fname in os.listdir(os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test")):
    if fname.endswith((".jpg", ".png")):
        tid = fname.split(".")[0]
        test_images.append({"id": tid, "path": os.path.join(INPUT_DIR, "test", fname)})

transform = transforms.Compose(
    [
        transforms.Resize(256),
        transforms.CenterCrop(224),
        transforms.ToTensor(),
        transforms.Normalize(mean=[0.485, 0.456, 0.406], std=[0.229, 0.224, 0.225]),
    ]
)

device = torch.device("cuda" if torch.cuda.is_available() else "cpu")

# Model Setup - move to same device as will be used for inference
model = models.resnet50(weights=models.ResNet50_Weights.IMAGENET1K_V1)
for p in model.parameters():
    p.requires_grad = False
model.eval()
model.to(device)


# Extract Features - now model is on the same device as input tensors
def get_features(paths, transform, model):
    inputs = []
    for item in paths:
        img = Image.open(item["path"]).convert("RGB")
        t = transform(img).unsqueeze(0)
        # Ensure tensor is on the same device
        t = t.to(device)
        feat = model(t)
        inputs.append(feat.cpu().numpy())
    return np.concatenate(inputs, axis=0)


X_train_img = train_images[:]
X_val_img = []
X_test_img = test_images[:]

# Split training images (hold out for validation)
np.random.seed(42)
indices = np.random.permutation(len(X_train_img))
n_val = int(0.1 * len(X_train_img))  # Keep 90% for training, 10% validation
val_start = n_val

# Create hold-out validation set from training data
validation_indices = indices[n_val:]
train_indices = indices[:n_val]

X_train_img_filtered = [X_train_img[i] for i in train_indices]
Y_train_img_filtered = [id_to_breed[X_train_img[i]["id"]] for i in train_indices]
X_val_img_filtered = [X_train_img[i] for i in validation_indices]
Y_val_img_filtered = [id_to_breed[X_train_img[i]["id"]] for i in validation_indices]

# Convert image lists to feature extraction format for splitting
# Need unique IDs per list for consistency
all_ids = [img["id"] for img in X_train_img]

# Create training and validation feature sets
train_id_list = [all_ids[i] for i in train_indices]
val_id_list = [all_ids[i] for i in validation_indices]

# Filter train/test images based on ID overlap
train_img_data = [img for img in X_train_img if img["id"] in train_id_list]
val_img_data = [img for img in X_train_img if img["id"] in val_id_list]
train_img_data = [img for img in train_img_data if img["id"] not in val_id_list]

# Ensure test images don't overlap with validation (already handled since test is separate)
# Final split: use first 90% of shuffled training IDs for train, next 10% for validation
final_train_indices = list(range(len(train_img_data)))
final_val_indices = np.random.permutation(len(val_img_data))  # Shuffle validation

# Re-sort to maintain order
train_img_list = sorted([v for v in train_img_data])
val_img_list = sorted(val_img_data, key=lambda x: train_img_data.index(x))

# Actually, let's just use the initial split directly since IDs are consistent
X_train_feat = get_features(train_img_list, transform, model)
X_val_feat = get_features(val_img_list, transform, model)
X_test_feat = get_features(X_test_img, transform, model)

# Label encoding
label_idx = {name: i for i, name in enumerate(breeds)}
y_train_cls = np.array([label_idx[y] for y in Y_train_img_filtered])

# Train classifier
clf = LogisticRegression(max_iter=1000, C=1.0, solver="lbfgs")
clf.fit(X_train_feat, y_train_cls)

# Validation Prediction & Metric - GENUINE HOLD-OUT (model was NEVER trained on this)
val_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_val_feat)
val_score = log_loss(y_val_img_filtered, val_proba)

print(f"Validation Multi-Class Log Loss: {val_score:.6f}")

# Submission on TEST DATA (unlabeled, model trained only on train)
test_proba = clf.predict_proba(X_test_feat)

# Build DF matching sample submission format
submission_rows = []
for i in range(X_test_feat.shape[0]):
    subs_row = {"id": X_test_img[i]["id"]}
    subs_row.update(zip(breeds, test_proba[i]))
    submission_rows.append(subs_row)

submission_df = pd.DataFrame(submission_rows, columns=["id"] + breeds)
submission_df.to_csv(os.path.join(SUBMISSION_DIR, "submission.csv"), index=False)

print("Submission saved successfully to submission/submission.csv")
